headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.orderedDefectLabelIndices_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.orderedDefectLabelIndices (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑d) =
    some
      (↑((Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedCellEquiv r c U).symm
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalRepairLabels r c U L d).1),
        ↑((Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedCellEquiv r c U).symm
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalRepairLabels r c U L d).2))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.orderedDefectLabelCode_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (a : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.orderedDefectLabelCode (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑a.fst) =
    some (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalOrderedLabelCode r c U L a)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointAutoCorrectionCode_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (a : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L) (k : ℕ) (word : Fin k → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointAutoCorrectionCode (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L k
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑a.fst)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointResidualMatrixCode r c U L hr hc a) (List.ofFn word) =
    Option.map (fun X => OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑X)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalBitCorrection r c U L k a word)
